archive.confirmDeleteJobOrder:
⚠️ PERMANENT DELETION - TOP LEVEL

This will permanently delete:
• The job order
• ALL its job order items
• ALL associated batches

This action cannot be undone. Are you sure?
archive.jobOrderDeletedSuccess:
Job order permanently deleted!
Deleted: {deleted_items} items, {deleted_batches} batches
archive.confirmDeleteItem:
⚠️ PERMANENT DELETION - MIDDLE LEVEL

This will permanently delete:
• The job order item
• ALL its associated batches

This does NOT affect the parent job order.

This action cannot be undone. Are you sure?
archive.itemDeletedSuccess:
Item permanently deleted!
Deleted: {deleted_batches} associated batches
archive.confirmRecoverBatch: Are you sure you want to recover this batch? This will restore the batch and its associated job order item and job order if they are archived.
archive.confirmDeleteBatch:
⚠️ PERMANENT DELETION - BOTTOM LEVEL

This will permanently delete ONLY this specific batch.

This does NOT affect:
• The parent job order
• The parent job order item

This action cannot be undone. Are you sure?
